assertions.summary: Fresh BYOK conversation fc90139c returned a natural-Chinese skill answer, the renderer tap captured a boot-path slash_commands_updated event from source=droid-sdk with 101 merged skills, and the saved console showed no forbidden filesystem-search tool-call markers.

steps.action: Open #/guid, verify/select agentsapi-claude-opus-4-6-thinking [BYOK], and install renderer tap before sending
steps.expected: Cold/fresh conversation uses the requested BYOK model and boot-path events can be observed from the renderer stream
steps.observed: The model label stayed on agentsapi-claude-opus-4-6-thinking [BYOK]; ipcBridge.acpConversation.responseStream.on tap installed successfully before the message was sent.

steps.action: Send 你有什么技能 in a fresh droid conversation
steps.expected: Assistant replies in natural Chinese and enumerates actually-installed skills without filesystem-search tool calls
steps.observed: The settled reply enumerated live installed capabilities including 天气查询 (weather), 记账(艾财) (yaocai-bookkeeping), and 招聘帖发布（X/小红书） (xiaohongshu-recruiter); console search found no forbidden filesystem-search tool-call markers.

steps.action: Inspect renderer IPC tap and console output after session boot
steps.expected: At least one slash_commands_updated event is emitted during boot, preferably source=droid-sdk, and SDK skill sync is visible
steps.observed: Captured 1 slash_commands_updated event(s); first source=droid-sdk sdkSkillsCount=101 conversation_id=fc90139c; console also logged listSkills merged 101 skills (subagents: 0).

commands.observation: Confirmed the user-managed Electron CDP endpoint was reachable.
Confirmed the renderer dev server, CDP port, and WebUI port were listening.
Verified the live Electron process started after the fix commit time.
Connected to the running Electron app and opened the guid surface.
